{{Top}}
[[File:Padmefull3Throne.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Queen [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]]]
{{Quote|A Queen&mdash;a true Queen&mdash;doesn't simply sit back and accept the way of the world. ''[&hellip;]'' A true Queen grasps the world by the throat and squeezes her own destiny from it.|[[Nuso Esva]]|<ref name="Crisis">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
A '''queen''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] ruler of a monarchy and the female equivalent of a [[King/Legends|king]]. On [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and some other [[Planet/Legends|planets]], the queen ruled the planet as a whole. Some planets, such as Naboo and [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]], were ruled by an elected monarch. 

On insectoid worlds such as [[Kubindi/Legends|Kubindi]], societies were often organized into hives that were led by a queen. [[Zabin]] was the queen of the poor [[Zabin Hive]] on Kubindi.
